subject: Request: Penetration test artifact & remediation status for SIG/CAIQ (Acme Corp)
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: grc@acme.com
Date: 2025-02-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pen test report required for SIG/CAIQ upload

Hi Marissa,

We're finishing the SIG/CAIQ for our procurement review and the GRC portal is flagging 'penetration test report' as a required artifact before we can complete the assessment for Redwood. Can you provide the most recent penetration test report (or an executive summary plus a remediation status log) showing the scope, test dates, and current status for findings?

Specific asks from the portal:
- Date and scope of the assessment (external/internal/network/application)
- Whether customer-facing systems or data-plane were included
- The vendor who performed the test and whether the full report is vendor-controlled/confidential
- A remediation tracker with status (open, in progress, fixed) and target or completed dates for fixes

If you can't share the full vendor report, the portal accepts a curated executive summary + attestation + findings tracker CSV. Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA? Our legal/compliance team needs this uploaded to https://grc.acmecorp.com/portal/requests/18923 by 2025-02-21 to keep our procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Doe
Sr. Security Assessor, Acme Corp

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-02-15T11:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report required for SIG/CAIQ upload

Jane — thanks for the heads up and context. We're able to provide an executive summary of the November 12, 2024 penetration test (external + app-layer focus) plus a remediation log. A couple of quick clarifications so we prepare exactly what your portal requires:

- The November assessment was performed by SentinelSec (vendor-controlled report; full report is under NDAs).
- Scope: external network perimeter + customer-facing APIs + control plane used for hosted inference. Internal network scope was limited to selected jump hosts used in the test (we can list these in the scope section).
- The full vendor report is confidential; we will upload: (1) an executive summary PDF, (2) a remediation tracker CSV with per-finding statuses, and (3) an attestation letter signed by our Head of Security.

We can upload to your GRC portal directly if you provide an upload token or accept us attaching documents to the request. Otherwise we'll provide secure Drive links. ETA: I can get the executive summary and the remediation CSV to you by end-of-day 2025-02-20 if that works.

Looping in Vivek (security) and Aisha (SE) to validate scope details and remediation statuses.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-02-16T08:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report required for SIG/CAIQ upload

Adding remediation detail for the tracker and proposed redactions:

- Test date: 2024-11-12
- Vendor: SentinelSec (report is vendor-confidential; we will not publish raw exploit POCs)
- Scope: External perimeter + public API endpoints + control-plane instances used for hosted inference (no customer data exfiltration was possible during test)

High-level findings (summary for CSV):
1) CVE-2024-XXXX: misconfigured TLS on legacy proxy — Status: fixed (2024-11-20) — Remediation: proxy config updated; regen certs validated
2) Authentication bypass on admin API (finding reduced) — Status: in progress — Mitigation: rate-limit + WAF rule applied (2025-02-05), target full fix by 2025-03-05
3) Insecure S3 ACL exposing logs — Status: fixed (2024-12-02) — Remediation: ACLs updated, audit scheduled monthly
4) Low-severity info leakage (headers) — Status: accepted risk (documented), compensating controls in place

Notes on sharing: we can provide the executive summary and a sanitized findings CSV that maps to your portal fields: finding_id, vendor_summary, severity, status, remediation_date, notes. We will redact exploit steps and any data fragments.

I will prepare the CSV and summary and mark the ones with publicly disclosed CVEs so you can cross-reference. Attestation: Head of Security will sign.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: grc@acme.com
Date: 2025-02-18T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report required for SIG/CAIQ upload

Marissa, Vivek — this is perfect, thank you. A couple of quick follow-ups from our intake:

1) Portal requires a scope line item that explicitly states whether customer-managed private deployments (i.e., Redwood Private deployed in-customer VPC/on-prem) were in scope. If not, please state explicitly.
2) For findings marked 'in progress' we need the current mitigation details and expected remediation date.
3) Please include the signed attestation as a PDF; our auditors expect an explicit statement that the full vendor report exists and is held under NDA.

If you can grant upload rights to grc@acme.com, we can accept the Drive links temporarily but prefer portal upload. Thanks for the 2025-02-20 ETA — that fits our deadline.

Best,
Jane

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-02-20T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report required for SIG/CAIQ upload — materials provided

Jane — all set. We uploaded the required artifacts to the Acme GRC request (ID 18923) and attached copies to a secure Drive folder. Details below and attachments included.

What we uploaded to the portal:
- redwood_pt_executive_summary_20241112.pdf (executive summary with scope, vendor, and high-level findings)
- redwood_pt_remediation_log_20250220.csv (sanitized tracker mapping to portal fields)
- redwood_pt_attestation_signed_20250220.pdf (Head of Security attestation confirming the vendor report exists and is NDA-protected)

Scope note for portal: External perimeter + public APIs + control-plane instances used for hosted inference. Customer-managed Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) were explicitly excluded from the November 2024 engagement; we have a separate control assessment for Private installations and can provide evidence if requested.

Remediation snapshot (from CSV):
- CVE-2024-XXXX: fixed (2024-11-20)
- Auth bypass (admin API): mitigation in place (WAF + rate-limiting), target fix 2025-03-05
- S3 ACL: fixed (2024-12-02)
- Info leakage: accepted (documented compensating controls)

Attachments (also included in portal upload): redwood_pt_executive_summary_20241112.pdf, redwood_pt_remediation_log_20250220.csv, redwood_pt_attestation_signed_20250220.pdf

If Acme's portal needs the vendor name visible in the "evidence source" field, use: SentinelSec (vendor confidential). If your auditors need direct contact with SentinelSec to validate scope, we'll facilitate by NDAs.

Let me know if anything else is needed to close the GRC request.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: redwood_pt_executive_summary_20241112.pdf (PDF, 0.9 MB); redwood_pt_remediation_log_20250220.csv (CSV, 12 KB); redwood_pt_attestation_signed_20250220.pdf (PDF, 45 KB)
